Clans: Banished, Pyreborne, Luna Coven, Underlegion, Lazarus League (new in MT2); Hellhorned, Awoken, Stygian Guard, Umbra, Melting Remnant (returning, reworked); Wurmkin (returning, free with patch 2.0, Feb 2026); Railforged (paid DLC 'Destiny of the Railforged', Feb 2026; extra.dlc). Native types: Champion, Unit, Spell, Equipment (attached to a unit), Room (one per floor), Blight, Scourge; ChampionUpgrade = 24 champions x 3 paths x 3 tiers from {{ChampionPaths}} with absolute stats per tier (text starts with [attack/health]). Unit 'Ability (Name, Cooldown N)' = clickable activated ability. extra.banner = banner unit (deploy-phase ember). Lazarus League Infusions (Goliath/Blast/Madman/Enfeebling) are generated by Mix: cost 0, rarity 'Infusion (generated)', extra.upgrade_options. Railforged tokens (Crafted Equipment, Scrap Metal) have extra.token. cost_upgraded/text_upgraded are null (no printed upgrades; upgrades are stones). Excluded: removed cards Awake, Fortify, Memories of the Melted, Scrap; artifacts, upgrade stones and Pyre Hearts that reuse the card infobox; enemy-only cards; generated unit tokens (Draff, Imp tokens...); Funguy (Underlegion: Cardless unit token listed in the nav). keyword_glossary.Ability: Ability is a unique unit trigger in Monster Train 2. It is manually activated by clicking on the unit. Each ability has a cooldown; most abilities can only be used once every 2-3 turns.
keyword_glossary.Action: Triggers at the start of this unit's turn.
keyword_glossary.Advance: Move to the front of the floor.
keyword_glossary.Armor: Damage is dealt to Armor before health. Each point of Armor blocks one point of damage and is then removed.
keyword_glossary.Armored: Triggers when Armor is added to this unit.
keyword_glossary.Artificer: Equipment is attached to any ally of this unit.
keyword_glossary.Ascend: Move up a floor and to the back of that floor.
keyword_glossary.Ascension: Triggers when moving up a floor.
keyword_glossary.Attuned: Multiply the effects of Magic Power by 5.
keyword_glossary.Avarice: When a unit with Avarice deals unblocked damage, gain Gold equal to stacks of Avarice.
keyword_glossary.Buffet: This unit can be eaten multiple times.
keyword_glossary.Burnout: When Burnout runs out, the unit dies. Decreases every turn.
keyword_glossary.Burst: Attacks an additional time per stack. Remove 1 stack after each attack made this way.
keyword_glossary.Cardless: This unit was not summoned from a unit card. It won't go to the Consume pile and can't gain Endless.
keyword_glossary.Charged Echo: Wurmkin floor resource stored in Echo slots: added by Infused cards and some effects, spent by Extract and counted by Reap, Inspire and Shell.
keyword_glossary.Conduit: +1 Magic Power on this floor per stack.
keyword_glossary.Conjure: Triggers when this unit's ability is activated.
keyword_glossary.Consume: Can only be played once per battle.
keyword_glossary.Corruption: Unit takes 1 damage per stack at the end of turn. Stacks remain across turns.
keyword_glossary.Craft: Choose between 2 random upgrades to apply to a card.
keyword_glossary.Cultivate: Increase the Attack and Health of a non-Morsel friendly unit with the lowest health by the Cultivate value.
keyword_glossary.Damage Shield: Nullify the next source of damage.
keyword_glossary.Dazed: As long as a unit is Dazed, it can't attack or use any Action or Resolve abilities. Decreases every turn.
keyword_glossary.Decay: Unit takes 3 damage per stack at the end of turn. Decreases every turn.
keyword_glossary.Deployable: This card is drawn during the Deployment Phase.
keyword_glossary.Descend: Move down a floor and to the back of that floor.
keyword_glossary.Distinct: This card can't interact with cards that share its name.
keyword_glossary.Doublestack: Status effects added by this card are doubled.
keyword_glossary.Dragon's Hoard: Pyreborne resource gained in combat (max 8 by default); looted outside combat for Gold and Minor Pyreborne artifacts, or spent by a few cards in combat.
keyword_glossary.Dualism: Doubles the stacks of Armor and Buff and Debuff status effects applied by this unit.
keyword_glossary.Eaten: After the next round of combat, this unit will be eaten by the front unit without an Eaten ability. Triggers when this happens.
keyword_glossary.Emberdrain: At the start of turn, you lose 1 Ember for every stack of Emberdrain. Decreases every turn.
keyword_glossary.Enchant: Other units on the same floor gain a bonus.
keyword_glossary.Endless: When this unit dies, return its card to the top of the draw pile.
keyword_glossary.Ephemeral: Purges when played, discarded, or at end of turn.
keyword_glossary.Equipment: Card type attached to a friendly unit for a passive effect and/or stats; one Equipment per unit.
keyword_glossary.Equipped: Equipment is attached to this unit.
keyword_glossary.Etch: Triggers when a card is Consumed on this floor.
keyword_glossary.Explosive: All excess damage is applied to each enemy unit.
keyword_glossary.Extract: Lose Charged Echo in order to play this card or activate this ability.
keyword_glossary.Fate Link: Can not be killed until all units with Fate Link are at 1 HP. Immune to Rooted and Entropy is immune to Dazed.
keyword_glossary.Forge: Gain Forge Points; the next Unit or Equipment you play spends all of them for +3 Attack and +3 Armor per point (Railforged).
keyword_glossary.Fragile: If this unit loses health, it dies.
keyword_glossary.Frostbite: Unit takes 1 damage per stack at the end of turn. Decreases every turn.
keyword_glossary.Frozen: A Frozen card is not discarded at end of turn. Frozen is removed when the card is played.
keyword_glossary.Fuel: Negates the effects of Inert. Loses 1 stack every turn.
keyword_glossary.Full Moon: Active only during the Full Moon.
keyword_glossary.Gorge: Triggers when this unit eats a unit.
keyword_glossary.Graft: Unit has equipment grafted to their body. When they die, the graft is severed for the rest of combat and the equipment goes into your hand.
keyword_glossary.Harvest: Triggers when a unit on this floor dies.
keyword_glossary.Haste: Moves directly from the first floor to the third floor.
keyword_glossary.Hatch: Triggers when an Egg unit loses its last Shell stack (see Shell); the Egg becomes the hatched unit.
keyword_glossary.Heartless: A unit with Heartless cannot be healed.
keyword_glossary.Hellborne Harvest: Triggers when one of your units dies on this floor.
keyword_glossary.Holdover: When played, this card is put on top of your draw pile next turn.
keyword_glossary.Hunger: Triggers when a unit with Eaten is summoned.
keyword_glossary.Immobile: Can't move between floors or change position on this floor.
keyword_glossary.Incant: Triggers when you play a spell on this floor.
keyword_glossary.Inert: This unit cannot attack unless it has Fuel.
keyword_glossary.Infested: +1 Attack per Infested stacks on the Train at turn start.
keyword_glossary.Infused: When played, the current floor will gain 1 Charged Echo.
keyword_glossary.Infusion: This card cannot be discarded or copied for any reason and is not discarded at the end of the turn. While in your hand, Mix effects will upgrade this card instead of creating a new card.
keyword_glossary.Inspire: Triggers when you gain Charged Echo on this floor, once per Charged Echo.
keyword_glossary.Intrinsic: Starts in your first hand post Deployment Phase.
keyword_glossary.Lifesteal: When a unit with Lifesteal attacks, it restores health equal to the damage dealt.
keyword_glossary.Live to Fight: Instead of entering the Pyre room this unit moves back to the bottom floor.
keyword_glossary.Loop: Triggers when this unit returns to the bottom floor.
keyword_glossary.Mageblade: +1 Attack per stack for each Magic Power on the floor.
keyword_glossary.Magic Power: Increases the amount of damage dealt and health restored by spells.
keyword_glossary.Malaise: -1 Attack and -1 Health per stack. Health cannot be reduced below 1.
keyword_glossary.Mass: +2 Attack per stack. Powers Fleshweaver's abilities.
keyword_glossary.Melee Weakness: The next time the unit is attacked, it takes that much damage again for each stack of Melee Weakness.
keyword_glossary.Mix: Create a new Infusion card if you don't already have one, otherwise upgrade the Infusion you have. You have two random options to choose from.
keyword_glossary.Moon Phase: Luna Coven: combat alternates New Moon / Full Moon at the start of each turn (starts New Moon); Phase cards advance it, Full Moon / New Moon effects work only in that phase.
keyword_glossary.Mooncycle: Triggers when the moon changes phases.
keyword_glossary.Multistrike: Attacks an additional time per stack.
keyword_glossary.Mute: Disables Triggers, Abilities, and Enchants. Decreases every turn.
keyword_glossary.New Moon: Active only during the New Moon.
keyword_glossary.Offering: If discarded before the end of your turn, it will instead be played.
keyword_glossary.On Team Turn: Triggers when this unit's team starts fighting.
keyword_glossary.Persistent: This card cannot be discarded for any reason, and is not discarded at the end of the turn.
keyword_glossary.Phase: Advances the current phase of the moon. There are two moon phases, New Moon and Full Moon. Cannot occur during combat.
keyword_glossary.Piercing: Damage effects with Piercing ignore Damage Shield, Spell Shield, Titanite, Titanskin, and Armor.
keyword_glossary.Propagate: Increase the stack count of Buff effects on friendly units and Debuff effects on enemy units, except Dazed.
keyword_glossary.Purge: Once played, this card is removed from your deck for the rest of the run.
keyword_glossary.Pyre Bound: Battles the Pyre Heart once a turn.
keyword_glossary.Pyrebound: Can only be played in the Pyre Room and the floor below it.
keyword_glossary.Quadrastack: Status effects added by this card are quadrupled.
keyword_glossary.Quick: Attacks before enemy units during combat.
keyword_glossary.Rage: +2 Attack per stack. Decreases every turn.
keyword_glossary.Rally: Triggers when a friendly unit is summoned on this floor.
keyword_glossary.Reanimate: When a unit with Reanimate is killed, it will be revived with 1 Health and lose 1 stack of Reanimate.
keyword_glossary.Reanimated: Triggers when a unit is revived from Reanimate.
keyword_glossary.Reap: Unit takes 1 damage per stack of 1 Charged Echo after combat ends. Does not decrease.
keyword_glossary.Refined: Increases Forge Points and Ember gained from Smelt by 1 per stack.
keyword_glossary.Reform: Return a defeated friendly unit to your hand. Apply +5 Attack, +5 Health, 0 Ember, and Burnout 1. These changes persist for the duration of battle.
keyword_glossary.Regen: Restores 1 health per stack at the end of turn. Decreases every turn.
keyword_glossary.Rejuvenate: Triggers when healed, even at full health.
keyword_glossary.Relentless: Combat in this room continues until all enemies are defeated. This unit cannot be rooted.
keyword_glossary.Reserve: Triggers if this card remains in hand at the end of the turn.
keyword_glossary.Retreat: Move to the back of the floor.
keyword_glossary.Room: Card type installed on a floor for a passive floor-wide effect; one Room per floor.
keyword_glossary.Rooted: Prevents the next time a unit would move between floors. Bosses are immune.
keyword_glossary.Sacrifice: Kill a friendly unit to play this card.
keyword_glossary.Sap: -2 Attack per stack. Decreases every turn.
keyword_glossary.Shell: Once all Shell is removed, the unit dies, triggering its Hatch ability. Apply the Egg unit's upgrades, equipment and stat changes to the summoned unit.
keyword_glossary.Siphon: Triggers when an enemy unit on this floor dies.
keyword_glossary.Slay: Triggers after dealing a killing blow.
keyword_glossary.Smelt: Consume a card in hand. Gain Ember and Forge Points equal to its base Ember cost.
keyword_glossary.Sniper: Prioritizes attacking the back enemy unit.
keyword_glossary.Spawn: Summon Funguy at the front of the floor. Trigger Rally for each one summoned.
keyword_glossary.Spell Shield: Nullify the next damage from a spell or ability.
keyword_glossary.Spell Weakness: The next time the unit is hit by a damage spell, it takes that much damage again for each stack of Spell Weakness.
keyword_glossary.Spellchain: When played, a copy of this card will be added to hand. The copy gains Ephemeral.
keyword_glossary.Spikes: When a unit with Spikes is attacked, the attacker takes 1 damage per stack.
keyword_glossary.Stasis: Cannot attack. Cannot be damaged or targeted in any way.
keyword_glossary.Stealth: Not a target in combat. Decreases each turn.
keyword_glossary.Steelguard: Cannot lose more than Armor 15 per hit.
keyword_glossary.Suppressed: This unit does not attack on its turn.
keyword_glossary.Trample: When attacking, excess damage is applied to the subsequent enemy unit.
keyword_glossary.Triplestack: Status effects added by this card are tripled.
keyword_glossary.Troop: Troop gains bonus Attack and Health per stack. Additional Troop stacks on a floor are added to any existing Troop. When this unit loses health equal to the Health granted by one stack, it loses a Troop stack.
keyword_glossary.Unpurgeable: This card cannot be removed from the deck.
keyword_glossary.Unstable: If a unit's Health is less than or equal stacks of Unstable at the end of combat, they die. On death, this unit explodes, dealing damage equal to stacks to enemies on the floor.
keyword_glossary.Valor: +1 Attack per stack. Raise Armor to stack count if this is the front unit after combat.
keyword_glossary.Vanguard: Applies when the unit is at the front of the floor.
keyword_glossary.Witherbloom: This unit and adjacent units take 1 damage per stack at the end of turn.
keyword_glossary.X Cost: Spends all your remaining Ember. The amount spent magnifies the results.
